body:
Noelle's first real run (23 Nov 2026, 18:25 CT) accepted a Porch & Party studio plan for 30 Nov–23 Dec (a reel a day on TikTok, Instagram and the Facebook Page, plus photo sets) and queued 0 of it: `NAMED STOP [CALENDAR_UNREAD] porch-and-party:facebook-marketplace not read`. No Studio piece posts to Marketplace, and all three calendars the plan posts to were read.

- The stop now names only unread calendars the plan's pieces post into (`unreadTargets`). An unread channel the plan never touches no longer holds the rest.
- Fail closed: a platform with no known calendar counts as unread; an unread calendar a piece does post to still stops the queue, by name.
- Nothing else changes: the engine's calendar de-dupe, plan check and the reviewer pass on rendered frames all run as before.

Review class: none — Noelle's queue gate only; no content, money or data changes, pieces still pass the rendered-frame review before posting
Forms: none — no form touched

## Mutation proof
- Making `unreadTargets` return every platform's channel (ignoring what was read): "an unread channel no piece posts to does not stop the queue" and "an unread channel a piece posts to still stops it, by name" both go red.

## Self-review
- Tests: noelleSession + noelle, 43 passed (3 new).
- Real case: tonight's run had unread = facebook-marketplace and pieces on tiktok/instagram/facebook → now queues; before it queued 0.
- No path that posts without review was opened: the change is only which unread calendars stop the queue.
